# Re-fetch song library
remaining_library_song_ids=set()
i=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_song_library(access_token=spotify_token, page_index=i, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    for s in page:
        remaining_library_song_ids.add(s['song_id'])
    i += 1

missing_library = pre2021_song_ids.intersection(remaining_library_song_ids)
print('verification_remaining_library_total', len(remaining_library_song_ids))
print('verification_pre2021_still_in_library', len(missing_library), sorted(list(missing_library)))

# Re-fetch playlists
remaining_playlist_song_ids_by_playlist={}
remaining_all_playlist_song_ids=set()
i=0
playlists2=[]
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=spotify_token, page_index=i, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    playlists2.extend(page)
    i+=1

for pl in playlists2:
    pid=pl['playlist_id']
    song_ids=pl.get('song_ids',[])
    remaining_playlist_song_ids_by_playlist[pid]=set(song_ids)
    remaining_all_playlist_song_ids.update(song_ids)

missing_playlist = playlist_pre2021_song_ids.intersection(remaining_all_playlist_song_ids)
